name: Paying Money You Owe
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of faithfully repaying what is owed, highlighting that the wicked borrow without repaying while the righteous act with mercy and generosity (Psalms 37:21). Believers are instructed not to withhold good when it is within their power to give (Proverbs 3:27) and to recognize the spiritual and practical consequences of debt, as the borrower becomes servant to the lender (Proverbs 22:7). Furthermore, faithful giving, such as bringing tithes to God's storehouse, is met with abundant blessing (Malachi 3:10), and generosity should be done with sincerity before God rather than for human approval (Matthew 6:1; Luke 6:38).
